params.caption: 🎮 Total War: Warhammer 40,000 shows over an hour of new campaign footage A fresh look at the campaign of Creative Assembly's upcoming Total War: Warhammer 40,000 runs for more than an hour. It shows gear customization for your units and how fleets work on the campaign map. The footage also stresses that Space Marines are not always trusted and are hard to replace, so losing them carries a real cost. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 06:09 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @SEGA ⚔️ React if you're ready for the 41st millennium · 💬 Which faction will you play first? #TotalWar #Warhammer40k #CreativeAssembly #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
